reason: The proof matches the lemma's Hall-type semigroup condition and gives a standard dimension-count construction of degree-prescribed weighted-homogeneous polynomials whose common zero locus over an algebraic closure is exactly the origin. The incidence varieties I_{J,a} are correctly analyzed, the dimension bound dim I_{J,a} <= N-1 follows from r_J >= |J|, and the union of bad loci is therefore a proper closed subset of the parameter space. Choosing a k-rational point outside this bad locus is justified by Zariski density of k-rational points in affine space over an algebraic closure when k is infinite. The final scaling argument using weighted homogeneity correctly shows any nonzero common zero would place the chosen tuple in one of the bad loci, contradiction. No forbidden or undeclared dependency usage was identified.
